theory CodeReplay

begin

// Function signature and definition of the equational theory E

functions: fst/1, h/1, pair/2, sdec/2, senc/2, snd/1
equations:
    fst(<x.1, x.2>) = x.1,
    sdec(senc(x.1, x.2), x.2) = x.1,
    snd(<x.1, x.2>) = x.2

rule (modulo E) Generate_Code:
   [ Fr( ~code ), Fr( ~nonce ) ]
  --[ CodeIssued( $AS, $Client, ~code, ~nonce ), Once( ~code ) ]->
   [ Code( $AS, $Client, ~code, ~nonce ), Out( ~code ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Redeem_Code:
   [ Code( $AS, $Client, code, nonce ), In( code ), Fr( ~token ) ]
  --[ CodeRedeemed( $AS, $Client, code, nonce ), Unique( <'code', code> )
  ]->
   [ SecChannel( $AS, $Client, ~token ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Deliver_Token_Securely:
   [ SecChannel( $AS, $Client, token ) ]
  --[ TokenDelivered( $AS, $Client, token ) ]->
   [ !ClientToken( $Client, token ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

lemma code_single_use:
  all-traces
  "∀ AS C code n1 n2 #i #j.
    ((CodeRedeemed( AS, C, code, n1 ) @ #i) ∧
     (CodeRedeemed( AS, C, code, n2 ) @ #j)) ⇒
    (#i = #j)"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ AS C code n1 n2 #i #j.
  (CodeRedeemed( AS, C, code, n1 ) @ #i) ∧
  (CodeRedeemed( AS, C, code, n2 ) @ #j)
 ∧
  ¬(#i = #j)"
*/
simplify
by contradiction /* from formulas */

lemma code_freshness:
  all-traces
  "∀ AS C code nonce #i.
    (CodeRedeemed( AS, C, code, nonce ) @ #i) ⇒
    (∃ #j. (CodeIssued( AS, C, code, nonce ) @ #j) ∧ (#j < #i))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ AS C code nonce #i.
  (CodeRedeemed( AS, C, code, nonce ) @ #i)
 ∧
  ∀ #j. (CodeIssued( AS, C, code, nonce ) @ #j) ⇒ ¬(#j < #i)"
*/
by sorry

restriction once:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Once( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Once( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  // safety formula

  /*
  expanded formula:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Once( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Once( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  */

restriction unique:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Unique( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Unique( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  // safety formula

  /*
  expanded formula:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Unique( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Unique( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  */

lemma code_redemption_reachable:
  exists-trace
  "∃ AS C code nonce #i. CodeRedeemed( AS, C, code, nonce ) @ #i"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all satisfying traces:
"∃ AS C code nonce #i. (CodeRedeemed( AS, C, code, nonce ) @ #i)"
*/
by sorry
